SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqCntnListMapper.getTotalCount : 비정상종료 내담자 게시글 수 */ COUNT(*) FROM AYB120 AA , AYB200 BB WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND BB.CHRO_NO = AA.CHRO_ID
AND BB.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 상담원 조회 */
AND BB.CLIENA_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 내담자 조회 */
AND BB.CHTT_BGNG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND BB.CHTT_END_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqCntnListMapper.selectInqCntnList : 비정상종료 내담자 게시글목록 */ AA.CHRO_ID /* 채팅방번호 */ , BB.CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(BB.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss') AS CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 채팅시작시간 */ , TO_CHAR(BB.CHTT_END_DT , 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss') AS CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료시간 */ , BB.CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(CC.BGNG_DT , 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss') AS CNTN_REG_DT /* 내담자 방입장시간 */ , BB.CNTN_IP_ADDR /* 아이피 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM AYB120 AA , AYB200 BB , AYB230 CC WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND BB.CHRO_NO = AA.CHRO_ID AND CC.CHRO_NO = AA.CHRO_ID
AND BB.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 상담원 조회 */
AND BB.CLIENA_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%' /* 내담자 조회 */
AND BB.CHTT_BGNG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND BB.CHTT_END_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
ORDER BY AA.CHRO_ID DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.inqChacttListMapper.selectInqCntnDetailPopup : 비정상종료 게시판 상세 */ AA.CHRO_ID , BB.CHTT_MEMO_CN /* 채팅메모내용 */ , TO_CHAR(BB.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss') AS CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 채팅시작일시 */ FROM AYB120 AA , AYB200 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CHRO_ID = #{CHRO_NO} AND BB.CHRO_NO = AA.CHRO_ID
